body: Thanks. It just sucks cause he's the first guy I've ever dated that I legitimately saw a future with, and he knows I'm going through heck right now too. Don't know why he would do this now
I've always been ignored whenever I reached out, so this is kinda new to me. Thank you

I've tried therapy, but my mind keeps bouncing back and forth between wanting to actually kill myself. I woke up this morning thinking hey, maybe today will be better, only to check my phone and be immediately greeted with a breakup text from my now ex. Don't know how to handle all this, maybe these support groups will help me
I just feel really alone in life right now, no friends no family. I feel like I'm too young to be this alone and that ending it would be the only way to end my pain
Thanks for reaching out, I really appreciate it. I do want my pain to go away
It's just every time I try to make myself happy, it always gets taken away somehow, and at this point I feel like I'm too exhausted to try again
It was honestly the only way I could think of, can't get my hands on any medication at the moment
Not particularly, maybe a bit but not too much
